### Special People for Special Times
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-october-8-9-2016.html
Passage: Ezekiel 22:30
Points:
- In spiritually dark times, God looks for courageous individuals willing to stand up for truth alone.
- Standing in the gap requires combining a tender heart toward God with resilience against cultural pressure.
- Believers must evaluate their own integrity to resist compromising their morals for success or social acceptance.
- God calls people across every profession and station in life to stand firm and proclaim His lordship.

### Is God Looking for You?
Author: T. Suzanne Eller
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-22-2011.html
Passage: Ezekiel 22:30
Points:
- Remaining silent while a loved one drifts into sin often stems from personal fear rather than love.
- Standing in the gap means being willing to initiate hard conversations saturated in prayer and love.
- Like Ezekiel, believers are called to share God's truth faithfully without control over the outcome.
- Interceding effectively means offering encouragement, listening well, and pointing others toward God's mercy.
